title: Why Every US Social Security Number Has Three Forbidden Numbers Hidden Inside

card_alts.card1: US SSN format: AAA-GG-SSSS, with three exclusion rules on the area field (no 000, 666, or 900-999), group field (no 00), and serial field (no 0000)
card_alts.card2: The famous SSN placeholder 078-05-1120, printed on 40,000 wallet inserts in the 1940s. Structurally valid format but trusted by no real system
card_alts.card3: On June 25, 2011 the SSA switched to randomized SSN assignment, breaking the geographical mapping encoded in the area number for 75 years
